comments: Locality of apartment is very good, only 10 minutes away from shops and restaurant, road noise is noticeable but not an issue for us

Wenn we arrived Julieta made us a cup of coffee and told us the places we should visit. Futher she explaned wich routes we could take. During the week she stayed in contact with us ans send us whatsap messeges with touristic tips.
Julieta gives you the feeling to feel at home.

Filipa’s Airbnb was wonderful! It was a beautiful space with a great view. The location was central to lots of restaurants and activities in Porto, and an easy walk to Gaia as well. Would strongly recommend staying here!
Marco’s place was in what felt like a quieter place in Porto,  but everything is walkable! Easy to get around to stores, the churches, and train stations. Was a good stay!

Nice place in Porto, lots of restaurants and sites to visit around the apartment. The train station is close by. Spacious, clean and sunny. A little noisy on the street but it's a lively neighborhood. I recommend it.

We enjoyed our stay here. Apartment is nice and clean with a nice bathroom. It is located in the city center close to the main sights, but also in a street with a lot of bars (can be quite loud at night). Check in was as easy as the communication. We can definitely recommend staying here.

Perfect! A most hospitable welcome from Luis, who immediately provided extensive information for enjoying the pleasures of the neighborhood, the city, and the surrounding area (and a complimentary port); a spacious, beautifully and comfortably furnished apartment, with modern kitchen, that provided a quiet haven to return to after days of exploring; an excellent location in walking distance of most of Porto's interesting sights, good restaurants, river front. Extra nice touches in fresh French rolls delivered each morning and the provision of butter, jams, coffee and several other snacks, excellent wifi, and for those who need it, TV reception. And friendly, helpful staff! Yes, perfect!

Eugenia and Luis' place was absolutely perfect!! I cannot express how charming the place is and how comfortable and convenient the location is to nearly everything you want to see and do in Porto. The directions from the train station were fantastic and a great help! We were greeted by Eugenia who made sure to be there by our arrival time (even though we booked last minute and arrived in the evening). We were given great tips for what to do and see around the city and this helped us plan our time in Porto. We arrived on a Sunday and by the time we got ready for dinner many places had closed, but, Eugenia called some restaurants and got us reservations at a great little place down the street. I can't explain how much we felt at home from the minute we entered the place. Highly recommended and we'll definitely stay here again when we return to Porto!!
We had a great stay for an extended weekend at this extraordinary place. Eugenia was a great host, welcoming us with many tips and providing a small breakfast every morning!

Fantastic place that’s perfectly located to explore this city, or simply just sit in the garden and gaze at its beauty. The apartment is old, yes, but has lots of charm and all the functionality one needs - for the few hours one isn’t strolling around Porto and it’s surroundings.

This place is gorgeous! I highly recommend. The location is perfect. It is right in the middle of everything and is very easy to walk anywhere in the city center that you will want. The view is breathtaking. The space itself is even nicer in person.
The space is a bit hard to find, but the host offers detailed pictures and directions that helped a lot.
We rented a car, and were worried about how we would park, but since it is a bit removed from the main street you can park up on the street near the cathedral. It is actually in a space that seems like it wouldn't be allowed, but was totally fine.
The host was very responsive and flexible. We were given a map and some great recommendations.
Thanks for a wonderful stay!

This stay was a top for us! The patio was an amazing place to relax and unwind in the morning and evenings. The place was quite spacious, beds were very comfortable, and overall just a wonderful location!!
Great place, we enjoyed our short stay. Apartment had everything that we needed. Host was very friendly and communicated great. Very central location, everything is close by. Definitely recommend.
Nicely renovated apartment in the heart of Porto. You can reach nearly anything by foot and the host offered some nice tipps to eat and do

We had such an amazing time at Toc Toc studio. Hugo promptly met us outside the building and gave us a very thorough and friendly tour. Everything about the studio was perfect. Everything we needed was there, big amazing windows, and central location. Hugo had complimentary port waiting for us which was wonderful. Hugo had fantastic suggestions for enjoying Porto. We definitely recommend Toc Toc Studio. Thanks Hugo!

Yes, the place is great, accurate, clean and in a phenomenal location. Would stay here again.
What I need to emphasize though is how wonderful of a host Hugo is. I’ve been to many Airbnb’s through the years and Hugo went above and beyond any host I’ve previously encountered. From communication to his personalized recommendation map (what a touch!), my trip was completely enhanced because of Hugo.

Hugo is a spectacular host! The space is perfectly located in the city, close to markets, restaurants, shops, etc...  Our flight arrived late and Hugo was so kind to wait until 1:00am to meet us at the airbnb. Gave us wonderful recommendations and even port wine as a welcome drink. He arranged a taxi driver to pick us up from the airport- Tiago, which also provided us with a great service. Will stay here my next time in Porto!

Hugo’s place was very easy to find and he provided helpful instructions on how to get to it. It was located in a great neighbourhood and located within close proximity to various restaurants and monuments. The apartment was fairly well maintained and not too loud at night which was great! We would recommend!
We had a great stay, the terrace is nice and private and very comfortable with two bedrooms and two bathrooms

Perfect stay in the heart of Porto. Just a few walking minutes to the night life centre and the river. Abel was a kind host who had nice recommendations that helped a lot. The apartment is as fancy as in the pictures and has everything you need to recover from long days and nights in Porto.
Arne

Great experience! The host was very helpful and the house was amazing. The neighbourhood is really nice, and close to the center. I'll be saving this one for future visits to Porto. Would recommend to friends and family!

Rita is a great host!
The place is great..great location . You can walk everywhere. Near all the main attractions, restaurants and all transportations: taxi, train and bus. Small grocery store near by and even a gym!
Thé place was super clean , very modern perfect for a couple . The apartment is on the third floor with no elevator…. But who cares…lol
I would go back for sure!!
Thank you Rita for letting us stay in your lovely apartment.

Marcia is very very communicative and nice. She replied to our questions instantly and she gave all the useful information. The house is situated in a very strategic place and easily accesible to the city center. The house is very clean and well equipped. The balcony is absolutely a luxury. Highly recommend without any hesitation :)
Really nice place, good communication with super friendly Marcia who fix any problem or question super quickly, a small coffee machine could be nice :)

Highly recommend! The apartment was clean, very spacious and had an amazing balcony. Antonio picked us up from the airport and dropped us off as well. He gave us plenty of local restaurants to try and overall he gave our stay a nice personal touch.
Our stay at the apartment was fantastic! The location is unrivalled, and the hosts were very welcoming and communicative. Would definitely recommend.

beautiful apartment with terrace and views. walkable to all areas. excellent space for 5 people, 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms.  standing fans in each room were great since it was warm at night even in October. alexandra was amazing, helpful with map and lists of everythingto do. wonderful time, will be back!

I arrived in Porto in the night and my host picked me up at the airport(for free). She was very accessible and easy to communicate with. Flat was very clean and there was a orange tree in the garden. I could smell the orange and it helped me to sleep well :) she also provided small breakfast. I definitely want to be back for another vacation!
Very experienced and efficient host. Apartment was just as advertised. Very clean and tidy. Nice and calm neighbourhood.
We had a great stay at Eduardo's apartment. It was comfortable and central enough to the rest of the city. Thank you!

Perfectly located apartment, a short walk from the metro that takes you into the main tourist attractions and if you walk only about 30min to the river. We loved being in this more local area with a great square and fountain and lovely bakeries. Vivian left lovely touches in the apartment and we appreciated her notes and information places throughout. The bed was comfortable and we loved letting fresh air in from the huge patio. We would stay again in a heartbeat. Thanks Vivian!

As other reviews mentioned, there’s a funky smell throughout the place…And we found it a little bit cold in the apartment. But honestly I don’t know if that can be avoided in a historical home like this one - The charm outweighs the negatives. There are heaters in each room but they can’t really keep upbeat the high ceilings. We would stay here again, just maybe bring warmer clothes next time.
The location is central, walking distance to many good restaurants, cafes and attractions. The apartment is clean, ORM Team is very responsive. Check-in is smooth and very positive.

The apartment is located on the first floor of a traditional building. It is stylish, comfortable and very clean. Well appointed with all necessary kitchen utensils etc. Fresh, crisp bed linen and fluffy towels provided. Really good, powerful shower which is easy to control for the temperature. Perfect for a couple.  Checked in by Claudia who was friendly, helpful and informative. The location is superb, just a 10 mins walk from the Metro which runs direct from the airport. It suited us perfectly as everything was within walking distance, ie main sights, tours, great shops and eateries. We even walked over to Gaia on the other side of the river.  Bring good walking shoes! Loved our stay here and would recommend.
Great location near the metro and within walking distance of the centre. The appartment was quiet , clean and plenty of space in a nice old building. The communication as also good.

This was a lovely apartment, very central and very accessible to get to from the airport using the metro. Arrived late at night and the host Nico was there to meet us. Recommend to anyone staying in Porto.

This is a fantastic AirBnB property in a great location with great hosts. Property looks as good in person as it does in the pictures. It is clean and comfortable and has everything one can need. The AC worked well and the hot water was strong and plentiful.
The hosts went out of their way to help us at check-in and check-out and to make our stay comfortable. They offered nice gifts upon arrival and gave great recommendations on things to do, places to eat, and sights to be seen.
A+ experience that I recommend to everyone.
The unit was clean and neat. Check-in was easy and the unit was well located. We had everything we needed.

This Airbnb was beautiful, it was very spacious and the garden terrace was ideal. I couldn’t mark it higher than 4 stars due to the lack of aircon. There were 4 people staying in an attic room with a tiny window and it got unbearably hot, it was difficult to sleep.
Great location to explore Porto.  The apartment had everything we needed and the parking space was really useful. Daniel was very helpful - we had a great stay

Susana is incredible and goes above and beyond to make sure you have an amazing trip! She is also so responsive. I accidentally locked myself out one day and she literally answered me immediately and got me right back in. Everything is so clean and comfortable.
Incredible flat! The private roof terrace has the best view in all of Porto and the flat is amazing. Great value and location - a true hidden gem!
Really nice space. The communication was really clear and we got some nice tips and help for trips. The place is quite small, but very nice. We cooked our own meals and I just love the kitchen.

Great place to stay. If you don’t want to walk into the centre of Porto then the metro is just 3 minutes away. There is a lovely pastry shop below for breakfast and the owners speak English. Pedro de Fragoes is a wonderful restaurant for dinner and is only a 5 minute walk away.
This place is perfect for a weekend in Porto.

Staying at Dino & Ines’s Airbnb is highly recommended! We felt extremely welcomed and the home was very beautiful and cozy. We were welcomed with fresh bread, wine and baked caked! It was amazing. The area is phenomenal and we will definitely be coming back!!

Luis was the perfect host and his place was an excellent choice. Located in a very walkable area, lots of restaurants  and shops nearby. The apartment itself was clean, well-decorated, and comfortable. Luis was able to give us a flexible check-in which was so helpful because of our early flight arrival time. Stay here, you will not regret it!

This apartment was perfect for the two of us as we each had our own bedroom and bathroom! It was very walkable to a nearby metro stop and restaurants.
The host, Daniel was extremely responsive before and during our stay.
It was very quiet, extremely clean and the beds were very comfortable!
I highly recommend this home!

Best Location in town !!! - Very clean and Cozy.
I would definitely come back next stay in Porto !!!
We had a nice trip to Porto, where we enjoyed this airbnb very much. Everything was as expected, and we had a good communication with the host.

Pedro is the best AirBNB host we have ever had! Very friendly and took time to show us around and give us plenty of local tips (the sandwiches are a must).
The apartment is spacious, clean and has a great location within close walking distance to everything but a little out of the touristy areas. Highly recommend visiting Porto and staying at this apartment!

Pedro was a great host, he is kind and friendly and quick to respond (both before and during our stay), and was happy to help with recommendations for restaurants/places to visit and even let us store our bags before/after our stay. The apartment itself was perfect for us: easy to find, lots of space, comfortable large double bed, clean, and in a great location for exploring the city. We would highly recommend staying here ❤️ thanks for a great stay!
The apartment is very nice and comfortable! Location is perfect, near shops, bars, restaurants and tourist attractions. The host was very helpful and friendly, gave us very useful tips!

Lovely studio, with just what’s needed for a great visit to the center of historic Porto.
We had a wonderful time. Thanks Margarida
Very good location, near by train station, exactly a few steps from the beach, quite surroundings with sound of the sea. The room was under our expectations. We were satisfied.

This is a great guest house. Everything was perfect. Antonio and Anabela are truly super hosts. I would give even 10 out of 10 on AirBnB :). They have a very friendly housekeeper called Paula who takes care of the place with love. I would definitely come back again.

Perfect location, most of the atractions are on walking distance, superb view, quite and cosy.
Good raport for money.

The views from this place are absolutely stunning! The accommodation was spotless and had everything I needed. The location was fantastic - so close to many attractions and restaurants within walking distance. Being on an upper floor meant a bit of a climb with luggage, but the provided water, snacks, coffee, and wine were a lovely touch. Loved my stay here!
Great location, needed a late check in so this place was perfect. Very clean and host always there if needed. Would definitely stay again.

We had the pleasure of staying at Nuno and Anita’s apartment, it was by far the best location we stayed at during our month long stay in Portugal.  Nuno and Anita were so thoughtful and made sure we had everything we needed when we arrived.  There even was a crib, high chair, and baby accessories available as we were travelling with an infant.  Communication was excellent, the apartment was extremely clean and well thought out.  We only stayed for 2 nights which was the biggest regret during the stay.  We will definitely stay here again when we visit Porto again.   Highly recommended!!!

Great place to stay. Excellent location- walking distance to Ribeiro and beyond yet quiet over night… if not for screaming seagulls. Nothing you can do about it except shut the windows. :)
Good communication and timely responses from the host. AC worked as needed. Thanks.
everything is OK. Couch is not new with some small holes or smth like this. apartment is comfortable for 2 persons.
Beautiful apartment , all there at use, Maria very nice and proactive.We had a problem with the shower head and the day after she has replaced it ;)
The apartment was beautiful and bigger than I thought. The location is perfect and the check-in is easy. I also forgot my keys inside and the owner of the apartment helped me really fast. Thanks!

We absolutely loved the apartment. It looks just like in the pictures and is perfectly located, right in the heart of everything and easily accessible from everywhere. For those who prefer a quieter place, staying outside the city might be a better choice.

We had such a great time in Porto. The location of the Airbnb was perfect and it was easy to walk to many great restaurants and sights. It was a great size for two couples and we spent a lot of time on the porch. Check-in was seamless and we were given the option to add in airport transfers which made our arrival and departure stress free. Will definitely stay here again if we get the chance to come back to Porto.
Wonderful space. Very spacious.  Great views. Easy walking distance to Porto's city center. The hosts were great communicators.
Very nice appartment, located from walking distance from city centre. Rooms are very spacious and there is a nice terrace to enjoy the evening 👍
Everything was great! Communication was spot on. My room was super clean! There’s a great gym nearby if you like to workout! And a great mall!
This house is very nice and comfortable for family trip. I want to recommend this place to my friend.

This is a beautiful flat, with amazing views. Great place to hang out during our rainy stay in Porto. Mariana was very helpful and the washing machine was an added bonus.
Two small caveats: two floor up means four sets of stairs so be prepared. And the kitchen was not easy, mainly because we couldn’t figure out how to turn on the stove!
I would highly recommend a stay here.

João is such a great host and all the team at the hostel are super welcoming and helpful. The house is perfect to use as a remote working base whilst exploring Porto.
There is a lovely private garden that gets lots of sun, great aircon and the house is very well equipped and comfortable.
The location is ideal with only a couple of minutes walk to a main train/metro/bus station with fast links to the airport. Lots of nice cafes and local restaurants in the neighbourhood too. Just an amazing experience!

a beautiful apartment located in the very center of the old town. the apartment has everything you need for living, and the view from the window is incredibly beautiful. the host is very communicative and answered all questions. thank you and we will definitely be back
This was such a great place to stay while visiting Porto! It is in a great location, with everything in walking distance. The balcony also provides great views of the city!!

We (group of 11) visited from the UK and stayed at the Migranja Beach House for 3 nights. The beach house was immaculately presented; had all the mod cons you could need (including a fab top floor bar area with an honesty box); and is within easy reach of local beaches and Porto. Rui was the perfect host, who gave us helpful information before and during our stay, including recommendations on cocktail places and restaurants. 10/10 and we would highly recommend this place to others. Thank you for an excellent stay!

It was really nice stay - flat was clean and cozy! Really nice window view, small balcony, windows can be closed and protect our sleep from daylight. At night it was absolutely quiet, and bed is very comfortable, so we slept very well!
Thank you so much!
Flat was clean and in good condition. The location is ok but a bit north so you have to walk a few minutes to get to the city centre. Overall we had a nice stay

Overall i had a pleasant stay for a few days.
The place was as advertised, a room at first floor after a narrow staircase; with small kitchenette, fridge, private bathroom and a nice view.
The room was quiet, clean and spacious and self check-in and out went flawlessly.
It is placed a few minutes from metro and Jardim do Morro and subsequent Luís Bridge, and there's a few minimarket nearby and a large Pingo Doce a 10 minutes walk away.
I didn't meet the host, but comunication and instructions were clear and extensive.
As other have mentioned, the mattress and pillows are quite stiff and someting to consider (it didn't bother me much).

All the attraction, restaurant and walking tour recommendations were great. We tried quite a few of them and found them all to be excellent choices. The apartment was well equipped & comfortable. The beds were comfortable. We came into town early and were able to drop off our bags which we appreciated.

The apartment itself was great, however, the communication was absolutely terrific. We didn't know how to check in until an hour before we arrived despite many attempts. When we were to check out, the office was closed.

The place was just perfect. Really good area with lots of nice restaurants and easy to get around the city. The apartment is just like the pictures. The bed was good and everything was clean and new. Would recommend everyone to visit this apartment when in Porto.
Alina’s place was clean, as described, easy to checkin to, and right in the mix of everything!
Aesthetically lovely and very comfortable. The garden was the cherry on the cake! Alice was available for information and instruction and we appreciated her kindness. Highly recommend

We loved our stay at this apartment. The location was great and had many places to explore and dine within walking distance. The apartment was exactly as pictured and was very clean. Check in was very easy and having a provided parking spot was extremely helpful. We would stay again!

The balcony was amazing ! The bed was a little bit small for two.
Great location. The hosts were helpful and responsive!

Pedro was a great host, super friendly and helpful.  We were able to do luggage drop off and park the car early, in order to explore while apartment was cleaned. We were able to check in early also. Pedro even carried our luggages to the unit. Beautiful quiet area but walkable to everything.  Apartment kept in shape and clean. Would stay here again

I stayed for 8 nights, this apartment is perfect for exploring Porto, very easy to walk to everything. Our host met us and helped carry our bags to our 2nd floor apartment. Everything was explained. Apartment was immaculate and was cleaned 3 times during our stay, with fresh towels and bedding. There are stairs to the apartment but we managed these, even my 75 year old mother. Would highly recommend for a stay in Porto.
The place was very clean and modern. Great location, only thing to say was it was very small and cramped, nowhere to put suitcases. Apart from that it was great
Very nice stay. Quiet apartment in a calm area. Very good and quick communication with the host company. Would definitely return here another time.

The flat and surroundings were perfect to visit the city! Very clean and quiet flat. More than enough space to stay with 3 (2 adults and a 15-yr old teenager). The little terrace is nice to have a relaxed coffee or aperitif. Coffee bar at the corner serves very good pastries as breakfast and the Japanese restaurant Kintsugi (Kintsugiporto) blending Japanese with Portoguese food was amazing, next to the various other nice restaurants close by. Do not hesitate to book the flat, you will not regret and will enjoy a wonderful stay in Porto!
Thanks, Hailey!
Great location and very clean, well-kept space. There were some minor issues with the amenities, but the host was responsive and helpful throughout. Would definitely recommend this place to stay.

Beautiful apartment and easy walking to everything, uphill of course. Clean and spacious and exactly as described. Filipe was very proactive with communication from original booking to start of our stay. Would highly recommend.
Wonderful place to stay in Porto.  Close to good food, shopping and dinks.  It was  a great time.  Lots of hills in Porto, so bring comfortable walking shoes.

Good location just 5 minutes to Santa Catarina nd Bilboa metro station, walkable to many attractions in center of Porto, many many restaurants near by, super markets. Very well decorated, comfortable bed and squeaky clean bedding.

I think this is the nicest airbnb for the price I’ve ever stayed in. My cousin and I felt right at home the moment we entered. Extremely clean and beautifully decorated. Hope to stay here again in the future!
A wonderful accommodation - very close to all the key sights/transport links and kept in pristine condition. Easy check in and out and a perfect stay, thanks!

We loved staying at Daniel's place in Porto.  It is not far from the iconic Luis bridge and within walking distance to most of Porto's main attractions.  It has a wonderful, peaceful balcony which one can see the Torre dos Clérigos.  A lovely place indeed.

Very good area to stay in Porto. Very central to everything but still very quiet inside the apartment. Couldn’t hear any traffic noise. It was very clean and tidy and comfortable to stay in. Would recommend and will stay here again

We had the best stay here. The home is a magical space with the most romantic beautiful panoramic views! We loved the pool, balcony and terrace. The house had everything we needed and was extremely comfortable. The surrounding area was exactly what we wanted to explore the old town, parks etc. It was a peaceful, quiet and relaxing stay. The host was super helpful responding quickly and giving local recommendations. I hope I can stay here again, it was super special!

Great location. Private and secure but welcoming. Super close to shopping and restaurants. Great hosts. Very helpful and organised. We were late arriving and it was no trouble and they were on hand to sort us out. Great place. Would stay again. And dog friendly which is always great.

I had a wonderful stay! The location was very walkable, which made exploring super easy. Raquel was such a lovely host, always friendly and helpful. The apartment itself was ideal — clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed. The balcony was definitely a plus, perfect for relaxing after a day out. Highly recommend!
